item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Star Zendaya Rumored To Lead A New Take On THE FUGITIVE
item.description: According to a wild new rumour, Spider-Man: Brand New Day star Zendaya is being lined up to take on the lead role in an upcoming remake of classic action-thriller, The Fugitive.

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Adds LANTERNS Star Aaron Pierre As John Stewart; More SUPERMAN Actors Confirmed
item.description: Some exciting casting news to report here, as the trades have confirmed that James Gunn's Man of Tomorrow has added Lanterns star Aaron Pierre as John Stewart...

item.title: LEGEND OF AANG: THE LAST AIRBENDER Promo Art Ages Up The Aang Gang Nad Reveals The Movie's Villain
item.description: Newly revealed promo art from the upcoming Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender movie reveals the aged-up versions of Aang, Kitara, Sokka, Toph, and Zuko, and showcases Dave Bautista's villain.

item.title: Silver Surfer's Origin Will Finally Be Revealed In FANTASTIC FOUR: FIRST FOES – SHALLA-BAL Comic
item.description: This June, Marvel Comics continues to expand on Earth-828's history with Fantastic Four: First Foes - Shalla-Bal #1, by Charles Soule and Mark Buckingham, the latest comic set in the MCU.

item.title: DISCLOSURE DAY: Full Trailer For Steven Spielberg's Sci-Fi Movie Promises "Everything Will Become Clear"
item.description: A full-length trailer for Steven Spielberg's Disclosure Day has been released, and it finds Emily Blunt and Josh O'Connor being pursued by Colin Firth's mysterious villain...

item.title: SUPERMAN Unused Posters Put The Spotlight On The Man Of Steel And His Closest Allies
item.description: A handful of posters not used in the marketing campaign for 2025's Superman have surfaced, putting the spotlight on the Man of Steel, Lois Lane, Mister Terrific, and Green Lantern Guy Gardner.

item.title: James Gunn Returns To The Daily Planet For MAN OF TOMORROW Prep; CLAYFACE Trailer May Be Coming Soon
item.description: James Gunn has shared a new photo of what will soon become the Daily Planet set for Man of Tomorrow. We also have an update on when to expect the first trailer for Clayface...

item.title: MONARCH: LEGACY OF MONSTERS EP Tory Tunnell On Titan X's Arrival, Lee Shaw's Journey & More! (Exclusive)
item.description: With the first three episodes of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters now streaming, we recently sat down with executive producer Tory Tunnell to break down the arrival of Titan X, Lee Shaw's journey and more!

item.title: RUMOR: Fede Álvarez Wanted Michael Fassbender For ALIEN: ROMULUS Sequel, But Ridley Scott Shut It Down
item.description: According to a new report, Alien: Romulus director Fede Álvarez decided not to helm the planned sequel after a creative clash with Ridley Scott over Prometheus connective tissue.
